scorecard.rationale: The Thai Parkinson study used rice bran oil as a placebo and planned MDS-UPDRS Part IV. It gives no painful OFF-state dystonia item or oil grade. The animal extract and mixed-oil studies measured catalepsy, rotation or vacuous chewing. The verified 2015 extracted rice bran oil experiment measured chewing stereotypies and rotarod performance. Its overlapping companion reports do not supply separately measured clinical rigidity or dystonia.
